title: Personal Agent Identity
description: Persisted local agent identity. Surface consumers apply a bounded projection to this extensible onboarding record.

agent_id.description: The onboarding-chosen agent handle. Same grammar as browser-onboarding.ts's identitySchema and concierge /api/setup's validator — looser than the NHI slug grammar, because it predates NI-01 and existing records are not re-slugified. See `nhi_id` for the durable, NHI-grammar identity this handle is linked to (FD-10).

nhi_id.description: FD-10: the durable NI-01 identity (`agent-identity.ts`) this agent_id is linked to. Populated best-effort by browser-onboarding.ts via `ensureAgentIdentityBestEffort` — never required, since onboarding must never fail on an identity-ledger write it cannot make yet.

trust_tier.description: Deprecated (FD-10 plan §2.5 principle 5): a free string that is never evaluated. The evaluated trust vocabulary is `agent-policies.yaml`'s `agent_tier`; `trustScore` / manifest `trust_required` project onto that same tier. Kept only for backward compatibility with existing onboarding records.
